first-journey.condition: Discover 5 different countries. A country is discovered the first time you enter it correctly during a game, in any mode.

european-explorer.name: European Explorer
european-explorer.about: You know the whole map of Europe.

geographer.name: Geographer
geographer.about: You always find the shortest way.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataDesc: Your progress is stored on this device only.
settings.resetConfirmBody: Discovered countries, history and achievements will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.aboutBody: Atlas works without an account or a server. Geometries: Natural Earth (public domain).

config.minRouteHelp: Minimum number of intermediate countries (maximum possible for this area: {max}).
config.attemptsHelp: Number of allowed mistakes, between {min} and {max}.
config.mapFullHelp: Off: the map reveals itself as you discover countries.
config.forbidHelp: These countries are never crossed, and are never the start or the destination.

errors.min: The minimum length must be between 1 and {max} for this area.
errors.attempts: Allowed mistakes must be a whole number between 1 and 30.
errors.noRoute: No route is possible with these settings. Remove an avoided country, pick a larger area or lower the minimum length.
errors.failed: Could not generate a game. Try again.

config.warnHidden: With the map hidden and no borders or names, the game becomes very hard.

goal.title: Connect two countries
goal.body: You get a starting country and a destination. Connect them by naming countries that touch each other, border after border.
goal.tip: The fewer intermediate countries you use, the better your score.

play.title: Type the countries
play.body: Type a country name (in French or English) and submit. The game ends as soon as your last country touches the destination: you never have to type the destination.
play.tip: A wrong answer uses one allowed mistake, with no explanation.

branch.title: Change direction
branch.body: You can restart from an earlier country of your route when the new country gets you closer to the destination. The old branch leaves your route, with no penalty.
branch.tip: Countries you already found stay discovered in your collection.

map.title: The map reveals itself
map.body: In Normal and Hard the map is hidden: only the start, the destination and the countries you find appear. At the end the whole map is revealed.
map.tip: Two hints exist: the first letter (−75), then the borders of a valid country (−150).

score.title: A score out of 1,000
score.body: Victory, an optimal route, no mistakes and no hints earn points. Every mistake and every hint costs some.
score.tip: Every day, three identical challenges for everyone are waiting on the home screen.
